verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents GDPR-oriented deletion and retrieval APIs and an EU Data Residency Program, which cover core retention/deletion controls, but the evidence pack lacks detail on AI-native/automated control (e.g., via API/MCP), granular retention configuration, or self-serve deletion workflows, and a breach disclosure raised concerns about data handling transparency. missing for 10: documentation of programmatic/API-driven retention policy configuration, MCP-based control of retention/deletion, granular per-project retention settings, and independent verification that deletion requests are reliably honored.
